MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.

2. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

5. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   D. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

7. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
